senses.sense_definition: De manier waarop iemand zijn dag invult, vaak in de context van zorg of begeleiding.

examples.text: Voor veel cliënten is de <w>dagbesteding</w> een belangrijke plek om sociale contacten te onderhouden.

target_lang_translations.en: For many clients, <w>day care</w> is an important place to maintain social contacts.

examples.text: De geestelijk en lichamelijk beperkte mensen werd passende <w>dagbesteding</w> aangeboden.

target_lang_translations.en: Appropriate <w>daytime activities</w> were offered to the mentally and physically disabled people.

target_lang_definitions.en: The way someone spends their day, often used in the context of social care, therapy, or support programs for people with disabilities or the elderly.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: General term for supervised daytime activities for those needing support.
Refers to the facility or program where structured daytime activities take place.
Refers to the actual tasks or social engagement provided during the day.
